title: Add a derived activeBlockers field to task view/list --json, computed on read (ODOC-480, QCLI-448 note)
description:
Filed from the opum-doc ruling on QCLI-448, recorded as a note on ODOC-480 at opum-doc origin/dev f6390ed883dd551c596a3828a45f08ef37076a2f, verbatim: "QCLI-448 note: I take the projection. task view --json and task list --json add a derived field (e.g. activeBlockers: blockers still in force, with a question blocker only while its question is open), computed on read and never stored. The raw blockers array stays as history, the normative spec says consumers read the derived field, and the change is additive. quest-cli files it as a QCLI follow-up with a both-ways test. The ruling is a note on ODOC-480 (the seq-179 rulings live there; the earlier ones were recorded under ODOC-607), so citing ODOC-480 is right."

CARRIER AND GATED: filed to own the work. Do NOT build until a plan is approved; it is deliberately not stacked on opum-ai/quest-cli#736. The QCLI-448 spec amendment (docs/specs/quest-cli-dependency-ready-set-and-blocking-design.md) already points consumers at this derived field, and names this task; until it exists, the raw blockers array is still what the CLI exposes and a question blockers clear is visible only in task list --ready, not in the record.

Why the projection exists: the raw blockers array is authored history, so an answered question block still shows as an opening event there. The derived field is the read-side answer to "what is blocking this task now", and it is the field the spec makes normative for consumers.

acceptanceCriteria.text: task view --json and task list --json carry a derived activeBlockers field: the blockers still in force, with a question blocker present only while its question is open
The derived field is computed on read and never stored: the raw blockers array remains the authored history and the stored record bytes are unchanged by a view or list

Both-ways test: a question blocker appears in activeBlockers while its question is open and is absent once the question is answered or withdrawn, in BOTH task view and task list, with the raw blockers array unchanged throughout
The change is additive: no stored schema change and no migration, a record written before the field existed gains none, and existing consumers of the raw array are unaffected
